learning_outcomes.text: Explain the concepts of occupational health and safety (OSH), its historical development and legal framework in Turkey and the world.
Recognize and apply OHS management systems and risk assessment processes.
Determine and analyze physical, chemical, biological and psychosocial risk factors in the work environment
Develop suggestions for improving the work environment in workplaces using ergonomics principles.
Will be able to develop prevention strategies by analyzing the causes of work accidents.
Will gain professional and ethical responsibility awareness by adopting a safety culture.

syllabus_topics: General Overview of Occupational Health and Safety and Safety Culture
General Overview of Occupational Health and Safety and Safety Culture
OHS in Turkey and the World, Basic Law
Occupational Health and Safety Services, OHS Boards
Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems, Risk Management and Assessment
Situations Deemed to Be Work Accidents
assessment_rules: The final success grade is determined by the contribution of in-term activities and the final exam grade. Semester Learning Activities contribute 40% to the final grade, and End of Semester Learning Activities (Final Examination) contribute 60%.
